gaps.sentence: ___ the weather improves, the crossing will be cancelled.
gaps.explanation: Unless = if the weather doesn't improve — matching the cancellation.

gaps.sentence: My sister is terribly reserved, ___ I'll talk to complete strangers.
gaps.explanation: 'Whereas' contrasts two parallel facts: her nature versus mine.

gaps.sentence: ___ his age, he still plays football every week.
gaps.explanation: 'Despite his age' — noun phrase after despite.

gaps.sentence: He is far from lazy; ___, he trains six hours a day.
gaps.explanation: 'On the contrary' rejects the description and states the reverse, more strongly.

gaps.sentence: No sooner had the applause died ___ the encore began.
gaps.explanation: 'No sooner... than' is invariable; 'when' would be wrong here.

gaps.sentence: The treatment doesn't weaken patients; ___, it speeds up their recovery.
gaps.explanation: 'On the contrary' asserts the opposite of what was just said.

gaps.sentence: She kept every receipt ___ she could claim the expenses back.
gaps.explanation: 'So that + could' expresses purpose; 'in case' expresses precaution.

gaps.sentence: British houses usually have gardens, ___ flats in Spain often have balconies.
